- **Sodium:** [Pedialyte Classic](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462865244839108,imageDocid:10862455122912668158,gpcid:13629127347452995203,headlineOfferDocid:17672714413295837409,catalogid:12592473235530464502,productDocid:9056715863448502116,rds:PC_13629127347452995203%7CPROD_PC_13629127347452995203&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwi0oc2rx6OYAxWSHUQIHb_2LEAQxa4PegYIAggHEAw) has about **1,035 mg** , compared to roughly **690 mg** in Electrolit (and **705 mg** in [Electrolit Zero](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462916374530969,imageDocid:1773516998116206023,gpcid:3214327318233931378,headlineOfferDocid:10241466036855303489,catalogid:18002529237361989973,productDocid:5418931260530559619,rds:PC_14927950173807474252%7CPROD_PC_14927950173807474252&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwi0oc2rx6OYAxWSHUQIHb_2LEAQxa4PegYIAggHEA0)). More sodium helps your body hold onto fluids.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXwRMIWDLmegUapmxWhU95YpitK-IkjKHx0_cX2uk4EOzERzQ54ddqe2KjAeg1XhCeS2NITqnwN5uhMIA18bYF1sVMQ1H8Jdayiups4DtHxv4UtDF1Uh68IABhU-dk7SC0-fLRvRjdxA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX-MHkxZt4ZjKWvvwy1aEo75FqRW7WLxmY3S4m0HGxdHGfgmvLqNIHc31mbRm_-OElB2i97HAUb3_C8DBwdNCDLR2mpPUCOLhnzUArKOz-Mte4Tnu7G47cEkb4bsBN32taTWMvpMB-)
- **Potassium:** Both are nearly tied at around **780–790 mg**.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXwRMIWDLmegUapmxWhU95YpitK-IkjKHx0_cX2uk4EOzERzQ54ddqe2KjAeg1XhCeS2NITqnwN5uhMIA18bYF1sVMQ1H8Jdayiups4DtHxv4UtDF1Uh68IABhU-dk7SC0-fLRvRjdxA)

### Which Should You Pick?
